description: Defines the MtpDataPacket class for handling Media Transfer Protocol data packets, including methods for reading/writing data, setting operation codes, and managing packet data buffers.

classes.name: MtpDataPacket
classes.description: A class representing an MTP data packet, providing methods for data access, modification, and communication with USB devices.
